title: A Tall Glass of Puker Juice
description: A Tall Glass of Puker Juice — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Audrey the Alchemist

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 10 Glasses of Puker Juice from the Fire Mutant Pukers in Upper Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Audrey the Alchemist

Repeatable: No

Zone: Algor's Terror Dome (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Collect 10 Glasses of Puker Juice from the Fire Mutant Pukers in Upper Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Audrey the Alchemist in Townston.

Offer:

It looks like the King's Board of Trustees has identified the first viable resource in Algor's Terror-Dome: Mutant Puker Juice. Most people do not understand that there is a certain juice that can be harvested from these creatures that is quite useful in my research on creating new methods to combat the mutants. With a good number of these juices I could continue this important research. Getting this essence from the Fire Mutant Pukers won't be easy, kind of like milking a cat, but it can be done, kind of like milking a cat.

Once you have juiced the Pukers return to me, Audrey the Alchemist, here in Townston for your reward.

Turn-in:

Great! With these I'll be able to continue my work. Let me know if this is something you can do for me again.

Objectives:

  • Glass of Puker Juice ×10

Level range: 10–25
